daily.sql: select day,site,sum(cast(received as decimal(18,3))) received,sum(cast(shipped as decimal(18,3))) shipped from raw_day where day=$d group by day,site

balance.sql: select $d AS day,coalesce(d.site,p.site) site,coalesce(p.closing,0)+coalesce(d.received,0)-coalesce(d.shipped,0) closing from daily d full outer join previous_balance p on d.site=p.site

turnover.sql: select $d AS day,d.site,sum(d.shipped) shipped_7d,max(b.closing) closing from daily d join balance b on b.site=d.site where d.day between cast(cast($d as date)-6 as varchar) and $d group by d.site
